shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -30

cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls Select FilePreview Avatar 2>/dev/null; cat Select/types.d.ts | head -120

cat Avatar/types/*.d.ts | head -80; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; cat ../hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls ../hooks; cat ControlLabel/*.d.ts | head; ls layout; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; cat ../../../package.json | grep -n '"version"'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && cat uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts; sed -n 1,80p uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -nE 'gap|direction|alignItems|justify|wrap|spacing' ; cat uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; ls icons | head -3; ls icons/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'upload|person|trash' | head; grep -o "'[a-z-]*'" uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -iE 'playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|testing-library|happy'
